tickets.title: Send share-transfer instructions for Moonbadger gift
tickets.text: Prepare and send approximately-$25,000 appreciated Velvet Acorn Growth Fund share-transfer instructions to Moonbadger Arts Center for Sela Mossbutton, using verified brokerage-delivery details from the joint-taxable account she holds with Jonah Mossbutton.
tickets.evidence: asked for agreed 2026-01-23 approximately-$25,000 share-transfer instructions to Moonbadger using verified brokerage-delivery details.

tickets.title: Obtain current pledge confirmation from Moonbadger
tickets.text: Obtain from Moonbadger Arts Center a current planned-gift pledge confirmation and receipt language covering goods/services for Sela Mossbutton's 2026 youth-workshop-fund gift, since the file only holds a prior-year acknowledgment.
tickets.evidence: Evan noted file has Moonbadger prior-year acknowledgment, not current planned-gift pledge-confirmation/receipt-language on goods/services; agreed 2026-02-06.
